epics.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
epics.jtbd: When a self-falsification audit identifies unresolved findings, I want the root causes to be fixed directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
requirements: R1: The mock API in serve.mjs must dynamically validate authorization.
R2: The E2E test mock-semantic-boundary.spec.mjs must invoke the real backend to resolve P1 refusal criteria.

slices.title: Patch serve.mjs and mock-semantic-boundary.spec.mjs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to patch the mock API and rewire the E2E test with integrated QA coverage, so that the self-falsification findings are resolved in exactly one work item.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a mock API request, When the request is made, Then serve.mjs should dynamically validate authorization.
Given the E2E test mock-semantic-boundary.spec.mjs, When it runs, Then it must hit the real backend and pass on CI.
